scientific_integrity: Self-contained all-length combinatorial proof; finite independent literal and integer-matrix tests; no independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Exactly ternary labeled alphabets, ordered overlapping bigram multiplicities, and nonempty bigram observations; does not count per-profile fibers or higher-order observations. The first-public date is that of the earliest checked motivation source, not a claim of priority for this theorem. An unlocated equivalent Eulerian flow formula remains possible.
title: Exact ternary ordered-bigram multispectrum counts and the degree-six law
